title: Committee of Supply − Head T (Ministry of National Development)
what_it_is: Committee of Supply − Head T (Ministry of National Development)

sections.label: Residents in HDB flats
sections.summary: As of 2014, an estimated 34,400 residents live in 12,609 HDB flats, very small compared to the rest of the island.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: As of 2014, this comprises an estimated 34,400 residents in 12,609 HDB flats − very small compared to the rest of the island.

sections.label: Green field development sites
sections.summary: Both sites will be almost green field, allowing housing, commercial and public spaces to integrate from the start without existing constraints.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: Both will be almost "green field" sites, allowing for housing, commercial and public spaces to integrate from the very beginning, without having to plan around existing buildings or constraints.

sections.label: Pinnacle price and equity
sections.summary: A Pinnacle 5-room unit sold for $1.08 million in November 2015, and Minister Lawrence Wong said maintaining equity and avoiding lottery syndrome is the biggest challenge.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: In November 2015, a 5-room unit in the Pinnacle was transacted at a whopping $1.08 million.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: Minister Lawrence Wong himself emphasised at last year's Kent Ridge Ministerial Forum that maintaining equity will be the biggest challenge as we develop Singapore further, and how we avoid the "lottery syndrome" for those who manage to successfully ballot for flats in prime areas should be something that the Ministry would look into.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: One way to look at the issue of equity is perhaps for the Ministry to relook at the leasehold periods.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: This is not new as we have already introduced varied leases for flats, such as those under the Fresh Start Housing Scheme.

sections.label: CPF grant and resale market
sections.summary: The Government announced a CPF Housing Grant for resale flats, but the speaker worries the free resale market could artificially inflate prices.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: The Government is doing much to address these issues, but we also need to plan and foresee future problems and have future-ready solutions, for example, the Central Provident Board (CPF) Housing Grant for resale flats which was announced recently in the Budget Statement.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: The grants, though reasonable, show the Government's commitment towards ensuring affordable public housing for all and a subtle nudge towards nurturing closer family ties, where young Singaporeans can opt to stay near their parents or in-laws.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: But I do have a concern that has been echoed, both in the media and amongst people in the industry, that the HDB resale market is still a free market: willing buyer, willing seller, as we have seen in the price for the Pinnacle@Duxton.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: So, how do we then ensure that the increased housing grant will not become a net negative if prices are, therefore, artificially jacked up, leading to an artificial inflation of not only HDB resale property prices, but the real estate market on the whole?

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: The Ministry has managed to clear the backlog of applicants for Build-To-Order (BTO) flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: If the unintended measure to spread out demand for HDB flats fails, young couples may end up back on the BTO list.

sections.label: Budget 2017 CPF grant
sections.summary: Budget 2017 increases the CPF Housing Grant for first-timer couples, giving more to those buying 4-room or smaller resale flats.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Randolph Tan (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Budget 2017 increases the CPF Housing Grant to couples who are first-timer applicants, giving more to those who purchase 4-room or smaller resale flats.

sections.label: Grant versus non-monetary alternatives
sections.summary: The speaker asks why a grant increase was chosen instead of non-monetary alternatives that could have relaxed constraints in a targeted manner.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Randolph Tan (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: An alternative would have been to increase supply by modifying the restrictions on resale if the buyers were young families and first-time buyers.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Randolph Tan (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Could the Minister clarify why a grant increase was decided on instead of non-monetary alternatives which could have also relaxed the constraints in a targeted manner?

sections.label: Extending Lease Buyback Scheme
sections.summary: Proposes extending the Lease Buyback Scheme to all elderly in HDB flats, subject to existing income eligibility criteria.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zainal Sapari (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: Property, in particular, would become an asset for many Singaporeans, especially when they consider monetising their properties for their retirement needs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zainal Sapari (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: However, the current Lease Buyback Scheme (LBS) is extended only to the elderly living in four-room flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zainal Sapari (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: Likewise, some of these residents are financially tight but do not have the option to participate in LBS because of their bigger flat size.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zainal Sapari (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: Hence, I would like to propose to extend LBS to all our elderly living in HDB flats but subject to the existing income eligibility criteria.

sections.label: HDB rental limit cap
sections.summary: States that they often fail to meet the HDB rental limit cap of $1,500 per household.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: Often, they would fail to meet the HDB rental limit cap of $1,500 per household.

sections.label: HDB appeal and interim housing
sections.summary: Asks whether HDB can establish an appeal channel and offer options for divorcees and couples with foreign spouses.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: Can HDB help to ameliorate their anxiety by establishing a direct appeal channel?

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: For those undergoing divorce proceedings, can HDB allow them to be in the queue for a flat allocation before the final decree is available?

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: For those young couples with a foreign spouse, can rental flats be offered as interim housing as they work towards a permanent home, or an option to enable them to own a 2-room flat without subsidies?

sections.label: Reviewing HDB rental increase structure
sections.summary: Asks whether the HDB rental increase structure can be reviewed to be more gradual or offset towards a flat purchase.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: Can the existing HDB rental increase structure be reviewed to be more gradual to minimise the disincentive of them earning more, or a mechanism be used to offset the increment towards their next flat purchase?

sections.label: Expanding ASSIST for single parents
sections.summary: Proposes expanding ASSIST so more single parents qualify, noting slow take-up of flats set aside since 2013.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: First, expand the terms of the Assistance Scheme for Second-Timers (ASSIST) scheme so that more single parents can qualify.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: I understand there already is a priority housing scheme for divorced or widowed single parents since 2013.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: I have read that HDB sets aside about 740 flats for the scheme as of December 2014, but the take-up has been slow and only 130 flats have been booked.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: To qualify, applicants must have sold their matrimonial flat before their divorce.

sections.label: Housing access for divorced parents
sections.summary: Proposes allowing divorced single parents with split care and control early access to subsidised housing despite the three-year time bar.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Second, allow divorced single parents with split care and control of children early access to subsidised housing.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: I understand that divorced couples are subjected to a three-year time bar where only one of them is allowed to own a subsidised flat.

sections.label: Unwed mothers as family nucleus
sections.summary: Proposes considering unwed mothers and their child a family nucleus so they can apply for HDB housing.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Third, consider unwed mothers and their child as a family nucleus so that they can apply for HDB housing.

sections.label: Single parents depend on discretionary help
sections.summary: Single parents depend on discretionary interventions by HDB personnel or MPs, with appeals and emotional letters used to secure flats.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Many single parents share stories about depending on discretionary interventions by HDB personnel or MPs to secure a flat.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The default answer of "please talk to your MP" to solve housing issues is actually quite prevalent on the ground even from voluntary welfare organisations (VWOs).

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Some parents have gone beyond asking their MPs to write appeal letters to even having their own children write the letters, believing that only emotional appeals would help move the needle on their housing situation.

sections.label: HDB support unit for single-parent families
sections.summary: Proposes experimenting with a small HDB support unit specialising in communicating and coordinating housing services for families transitioning to single-parent households.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The current lack of clarity by this particular user of how to navigate the system surely results in a great deal of wasted time and energy for everyone involved − the time-poor single parents themselves, the time-poor letter writing MPs and the time-poor civil servants juggling all the multiple cases.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: So, could we experiment with forming a small support unit within HDB that specialises in communicating and coordinating housing services for all families transitioning to single-parent households?

sections.label: Unwed parent under 35 housing
sections.summary: States an unwed parent under 35 cannot buy an HDB flat or enjoy family scheme grants, and asks if parent and child can form a family nucleus.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: A single unwed parent who is under 35 years old is currently unable to purchase an HDB flat or enjoy the housing grants under the family scheme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: It is difficult enough being a single parent and we should help rather than penalise them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: So, similar to what Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin has just mentioned, can the Ministry consider allowing a single unwed parent and his or her child to form a family nucleus when applying for an HDB flat?

sections.label: Housing application after interim judgment
sections.summary: Hopes single parents can start housing application upon getting the interim judgment of divorce, noting the ASSIST programme exists.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I am sure the biggest worry for any parent is whether they can provide their children with a roof over their heads.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: We do have the ASSIST programme, but I hope we can allow them to start the housing application upon getting the interim judgment of divorce since it is uncommon for the proceedings to not continue.

sections.label: HDB help for divorcees
sections.summary: Asks whether HDB could assist divorcees to obtain housing regardless of whether the individual has care and control of the children.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
sentences.text: For example, could HDB assist divorcees to obtain housing, regardless of whether the individual has care and control of the children?

sections.label: HDB rental flat applications
sections.summary: The passage asks whether HDB would allow such individuals to apply for rental flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Would HDB allow such individuals to apply for rental flats?

sections.label: BTO waiting period reduction
sections.summary: The Minister said in October last year the BTO waiting period will drop to two to three years from three to four years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
sentences.text: The Minister shared in October last year that the waiting period for BTO flats will drop to two to three years, down from the current three to four years.

sections.label: BTO checks and monitoring stages
sections.summary: A January 2016 Parliamentary answer outlined 10 stages of checks and monitoring for BTO projects' supervision, materials, equipment and potential issues.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: In an answer to a Parliamentary Question in January 2016, the Senior Minister of State outlined 10 stages of checks and monitoring to ensure BTO projects are properly supervised, building materials and equipment are of acceptable standard, and potential design, safety and maintenance issues are identified.

sections.label: Hougang Dewcourt design not elderly-friendly
sections.summary: At Hougang Dewcourt, a mixed development of 4-room flats and studio apartments, the design is not elderly-friendly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: At Hougang Dewcourt, a mixed development of 4-room flats and studio apartments, the design is not even elderly-friendly.

sections.label: Shelter overhang and walkway flooding
sections.summary: The shelter overhang falls short of the apron drain, so rain hits the walkway directly and turns it into a flowing river.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: The overhang of the shelter falls so short of the apron drain that when it rains, the water hit the walkway directly and turns it into a flowing river.

sections.label: Town Council taking over projects
sections.summary: The Town Council has to take over a project whenever the HDB says so.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: To further compound the issue, the Town Council has to take over a project whenever the HDB says so.

sections.label: HIP eligibility for older blocks
sections.summary: Two blocks built in 1986 and 1987 differ in HIP eligibility, with half of the blocks eligible and half not.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: One was built in 1986 and has been renovated; the other one was built in 1987, although it is already 30 year old, it is not covered under the Home Improvement Programme (HIP).

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: Half of the blocks are eligible for HIP while the other half is not, although they are only slightly newer.

sections.label: Difficulty buying 2-room flats
sections.summary: Residents report difficulty buying 2-room flats, including a couple who tried six times without success.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: Recently, certain residents have given me feedback that they have difficulty in buying 2-room flats.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: Last night, I saw a couple who want to downgrade, right-size, and they told me that they tried six times, still cannot get it.

sections.label: Upgrading needs of ageing flats
sections.summary: The Member asks the Minister what plans the Government has for upgrading ageing flats that do not qualify for HIP.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jessica Tan Soon Neo (East Coast)
sentences.text: As these flats do not qualify for HIP, can I ask the Minister what plans does the Government have to address the upgrading needs of these ageing flats?

sections.label: Shorter waiting time BTO flats
sections.summary: HDB will offer BTO flats with shorter waiting time of about two and a half years, starting with about 1,000 flats in 2018.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: But I know that there are many young couples who hope to move into their homes quickly to embark on this marriage and parenthood journey together.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, we have looked into their requests seriously and I am happy to announce that HDB will offer BTO flats in some projects with a shorter waiting time.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We are achieving this not by rushing the construction but by commencing construction ahead of launch.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, the waiting time will be cut to around two and a half years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We target to launch the first batch of such flats in 2018.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We will start with about 1,000 flats spread out among our non-mature estates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: At least 95% of 4-room or larger flats will be set aside for first-timer families, which is a 10-percentage point increase from the existing BTO quota.

sections.label: PPHS households and babies
sections.summary: About 2,000 households have lived in PPHS flats and more than 400 PPHS babies have been welcomed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: To date, about 2,000 households have lived in PPHS flats and we have welcomed more than 400 "PPHS babies".

sections.label: Lower PPHS rents
sections.summary: PPHS rents are lowered by $200 to $400 per month, with new rentals about or less than half of market rentals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: To help families further, we have decided to lower PPHS rents by $200 to $400 per month, depending on flat type and location.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, in the example of a 3-room flat in Jurong, with the new rent, it will be $600; and in Commonwealth, it will be $700.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Effectively, the new rentals will be about or less than half of market rentals, and couples taking up these options can save more than $1,000 a month by renting a PPHS flat instead of a flat in the open market.

sections.label: Resale flat housing subsidies
sections.summary: Resale flat buyers can enjoy up to $110,000 in housing subsidies together with existing grants.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: In fact, together with existing grants, resale flat buyers can enjoy as much as $110,000 in housing subsidies.

sections.label: Resale transaction process improvements
sections.summary: A resale transaction takes about 16 weeks and two HDB appointments, and HDB will announce details by year-end.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Today, doing a resale transaction can be quite an involved process, even with the help of an agent.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: It takes about 16 weeks to complete a resale transaction and requires two appointments with HDB.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: HDB is working on this and will announce the details by the end of the year.

sections.label: Singles booking 2-room BTO flats
sections.summary: 2-room BTO flats opened to singles in 2013, application rate fell to 6.6 last year, and 9,700 singles have booked flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We have opened up 2-room BTO flats to singles in 2013.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: And the application rate was 57.5 in the first exercise in 2013.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We have brought this down to 6.6 last year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: To date, 9,700 singles have successfully booked a flat.

sections.label: LBS maximum lease extension
sections.summary: Maximum lease under LBS extended to 35 years with no current plans to extend further, but HDB will exercise flexibility case-by-case.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: In fact, we have already extended the maximum lease under LBS to 35 years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We do not currently plan to extend further.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: But HDB will exercise flexibility to allow some needy seniors below the age eligibility criterion to tap on LBS on a case-by-case basis.

sections.label: Silver Housing Bonus for right-sizing
sections.summary: Right-sizing today gives the chance to get a Silver Housing Bonus of up to $20,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Today, if you right-size, you already get the chance to get a Silver Housing Bonus of up to $20,000.

sections.label: Downpayment deferral for seniors
sections.summary: Buyers aged 55 and above right-sizing to a new 3-room or smaller flat may pay downpayment and balance purchase price later at key collection.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We know that some seniors find it difficult to fork out the minimum 5%-10% downpayment, as their monies are locked up in their existing flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, to help them, we will allow all buyers aged 55 and above who are right-sizing to a new 3-room or smaller flat to pay the downpayment and the balance purchase price later, at the point when they collect the keys to their new flat.

sections.label: Temporary Loan for right-sizing seniors
sections.summary: Right-sizing seniors will get a Temporary Loan letting them complete the sale of their existing flat after key collection.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: In practice, we all know that it takes time to sell the existing flat and it is not always possible to time the transactions so perfectly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, we will provide right-sizing seniors with a Temporary Loan, which allows them to complete the sale of the existing flat after key collection.

sections.label: HIP upgrading batches and resources
sections.summary: The current HIP upgrading batch is being worked through, and subsequent batches are being studied but depend on Government resources.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We are still in the process of working through the current batch of upgrading for HIP.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We are studying the subsequent batches but, as I have mentioned before, this is contingent on the resources of the Government to fund such a programme because any upgrading programme is a major commitment that spans over many years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Senior Minister of State Desmond Lee will elaborate more on this.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We have significant infrastructure demands in our next phase of development.

sections.label: Public-private partnerships not silver bullet
sections.summary: Public-private partnerships are not a silver bullet because someone still has to pay through higher user charges or taxes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Private financing has been cited very often as a way around this, but public-private partnerships (PPPs) are not the silver bullet.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Ultimately, someone still has to pay, which means either higher user charges or taxes.

sections.label: Optimising land use for space
sections.summary: Land use is being optimised, and moving Paya Lebar Airbase and the city ports can free up more space for new developments.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We are optimising land use to free up more space.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: I mentioned this last year where, through the movement of Paya Lebar Airbase and the city ports, we can free up much more space for new developments.

sections.label: Jurong Lake District HSR Terminus
sections.summary: Jurong Lake District is also the site of the High-Speed Rail Terminus to Kuala Lumpur.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: One such centre is Jurong Lake District which, Members would be aware, is also the site of the High-Speed Rail (HSR) Terminus to Kuala Lumpur.

sections.label: Jurong and Punggol growth clusters
sections.summary: Jurong can be a Central Innovation District near knowledge centres, and Punggol North is designated the first Enterprise District with JTC as Master Developer.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: It is also close to other knowledge and economic centres, like the Jurong Innovation District, the CleanTech Park and the Nanyang Technological University campus.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, more than just another CBD, this can be a Central Innovation District, an incubator for new ideas and innovation and a catalyst for Singapore's next stage of transformation, the way Jurong Industrial Estate kickstarted our manufacturing sector 50 years ago Another new area is Punggol North.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: This growth cluster within Punggol New Town will have a focus on the digital and cybersecurity industries, and Punggol will be a key area for us to drive our Smart Nation initiatives.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We are designating this as our first "Enterprise District" where we will try out several new planning concepts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: In the Punggol cluster, most of the developments are undertaken by Government agencies, so we will appoint Jurong Town Corporation (JTC) as the Master Developer.

sections.label: Master developer approach, Kampong Bugis
sections.summary: The master developer approach will be introduced in other new districts, including Kampong Bugis, a new residential precinct.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Beyond Punggol, we are also looking to introduce the master developer approach in other new residential and mixed-use districts, where private developers will be given greater flexibility in planning and developing at a district level.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We will provide for such an opportunity in Kampong Bugis, which is a new residential precinct.

sections.label: Kampong Bugis car-lite precinct plans
sections.summary: Kampong Bugis will be a people-centric, car-lite precinct with walkways, cycling paths, green spaces and district waste and storm water systems.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We want this to be a people-centric, car-lite precinct.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We will require the master developer to put in place a more comprehensive network of pedestrian walkways, cycling paths, as well as community and green spaces.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We will also want the master developer to put in place district level systems to manage waste and storm water.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: The development of Kampong Bugis will form part of our larger rejuvenation efforts for the Kallang River.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: More homes will be introduced and the older industrial estates in the area will be rejuvenated.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: All these will be done in a way that is sensitive to the rich heritage and biodiversity of the river so that, over time, we can transform the entire riverfront and bring back new life and vibrancy to the area.

sections.label: MSO and Town Councils coordination
sections.summary: Minister Grace Fu said MSO would work with Town Councils on municipal issues and improve coordination on high-rise littering and pigeon-feeding.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development and Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: For example, during last year's COS Debate, Minister Grace Fu shared with the House that MSO would work with the Town Councils to help coordinate their responses to municipal issues in housing estates.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development and Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: The Minister also shared that MSO would look at improving coordination over a few issues, such as high-rise littering and pigeon-feeding.

sections.label: Town Councils agree to work with MSO
sections.summary: All 16 Town Councils have agreed to work with MSO, and the passage asks how successful coordination efforts have been.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: How successful have efforts been in bringing together different agency stakeholders to the same table to coordinate and improve upon municipal service delivery?

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: I understand from last year's COS that all 16 Town Councils have given their agreement to work with MSO.

sections.label: OneService App and MSO update
sections.summary: The passage asks for an update on the OneService App and notes MSO works with 11 Government agencies on municipal services.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: Can an update be provided on how effective the OneService App has been since its rollout and what plans there are to further improve upon this OneService App in the context of the Smart Nation Initiative?

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: MSO was formed to improve the Government's overall coordination and delivery of municipal services.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: MSO currently works with 11 Government agencies to resolve issues, particularly in areas where multiple agencies are involved.

sections.label: Fines for pigeon-feeding and littering
sections.summary: Pigeon-feeding is illegal and can be fined up to $500 by AVA, while littering can bring an NEA fine of up to $2,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Feeding of pigeons is illegal and AVA could fine an offender up to $500.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Throwing food out of the window or on the grass is littering, which could attract an NEA fine of up to $2,000 for the first conviction, and even a corrective work order.

sections.label: Local authorities linked datasets
sections.summary: Pioneering local authorities worldwide are building large linked datasets across local public services, and the MSO OneService app is a good start.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: But there are now pioneering local authorities around the world which are starting to build large linked datasets across local public services, opening up powerful insights.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: And the MSO OneService app is a good start.

sections.label: OneService app and PolCam
sections.summary: OneService app holds data from 11 agencies, and the 62,000 PolCam cameras in HDB estates could help solve municipal issues.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: On OneService app, there are data from across the 11 agencies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: For example, I find that one low-hanging fruit that we can consider is the 62,000 Police Cameras (PolCam) in HDB estates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: While the PolCam initiative was targeted at deterring and solving crime, the cameras and data collected would be very useful to solve many municipal issues.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: In the Budget speech, Minister Heng spoke about using funds to support cross-agency projects, including those from MSO.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: So, I would like to ask the Minister how MSO is seeking to use this fund.

sections.label: OneService app user growth
sections.summary: The app has over 83,000 registered users reporting some 85,000 cases, up over 70% in users and 190% in cases since last year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: The app has been well-received, with over 83,000 registered users reporting some 85,000 cases.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: This is an increase of over 70% in users and 190% in cases received since the start of last year.

sections.label: Case closure and routing accuracy
sections.summary: Multi-agency case closure time fell from 21 days in October 2014 to 12 days by end of last year, and routing accuracy rose from 85% to 88%.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: The time taken to close cases involving multiple agencies has decreased continuously from 21 days when MSO first started in October 2014, to 12 days by the end of last year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Routing accuracy of feedback has also improved from around 85% in late 2014 to 88% by the end of last year.

sections.label: Feedback systems connected
sections.summary: The feedback management systems of MSO, partner agencies and all 16 Town Councils have been connected.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Recently, we connected the feedback management systems of MSO, those of our partner agencies and all 16 Town Councils.

sections.label: Fund for interagency projects
sections.summary: MSO worked with MOF to set aside up to $5 million a year for interagency projects, which agencies can tap from May this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: To enable our partner agencies to pursue more of such innovations, MSO has worked with MOF to set aside a fund of up to $5 million a year to support interagency projects.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: From May this year, agencies will be able to tap on this fund to develop their ideas fully.

sections.label: Grass-cutting height sensor prototype
sections.summary: MSO facilitated GovTech's development of a height sensor prototype for grass-cutting that measures cut grass height and uploads data in real-time.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: For instance, MSO facilitated the development of a height sensor prototype for grass-cutting by GovTech, which measures the height of cut grass and uploads the data real-time as the contractor trims the grass.

sections.label: Commercialising the sensor prototype
sections.summary: After a successful trial, MSO will work with SPRING to find a commercial solution to the prototype.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Following the successful trial, MSO will work with the Standards, Productivity and Innovation Board (SPRING) to find a commercial solution to the prototype.

sections.label: Trapping stray dogs at HDB sites
sections.summary: Based on findings, AVA worked with HDB to trap stray dogs around infrastructure works and check canteen areas for food waste disposal.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Based on these findings, AVA worked with HDB to establish an arrangement to trap stray dogs before and after infrastructure works, as well as to check the canteen areas in HDB construction sites to ensure proper food waste disposal.

sections.label: Additional public construction projects
sections.summary: The $700 million of additional public construction projects is welcome, with hope they go to local contractors.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: The $700 million of additional public construction projects is much welcome and I hope all the projects will be awarded to our local contractors, creating opportunities for them to build on their construction capabilities.

sections.label: Hougang Avenue 2 residents cut off
sections.summary: After privatisation of the HUDC cluster, HDB residents at one Hougang Avenue 2 block are cut off from their NRIC-listed road.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat
sentences.text: For the estate at Hougang Avenue 2, HDB residents living at one block of flats suddenly find themselves cut off from the road that is listed as their legal address in their National Registration Identity Card (NRIC) after the privatisation of the HUDC cluster.

sections.label: Footpath now inside private estate
sections.summary: The original footpath used by all residents for over three decades now sits inside a private estate.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat
sentences.text: The original footpath used by all residents for over three decades is now sitting inside a private estate.

sections.label: Lamp posts power cut off
sections.summary: Three lamp posts lighting a service road had power cut off twice as they tapped electricity from the private estate.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat
sentences.text: Three lamp posts lighting that service road there had their power cut off a couple of times as these lights were tapping electricity from the private estate.

sections.label: Residents and HUDC privatisation planning
sections.summary: A speaker asks what residents should do when their NRIC road address no longer means what it says, and feels not enough planning was done for estates affected by HUDC privatisation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat
sentences.text: What should residents do when the road address in their NRIC no longer means what it says?

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat
sentences.text: I certainly feel that there was not enough planning done or consideration given to the surrounding estates affected by the privatisation of HUDC estates.

sections.label: AHTC warm lift shaft matter
sections.summary: AHTC told HDB twice that warm air in a lift might be due to the metal lift shaft conducting heat.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: AHTC had highlighted the matter to HDB twice, informing that the warm air might be due to the metal lift shaft which resulted in conduction of heat, hence, causing the air inside the lift to be warm.

sections.label: Overgrown tree roots damaging property
sections.summary: Some large trees at 1970s and 1980s HDB flats have overgrown roots damaging common property, raising maintenance costs and posing safety hazards.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: Many HDB flats built in the 1970s and 1980s today host trees that have grown very large and are an indelible part of the community.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: However, a percentage of these trees, whilst aesthetically pleasing and growing healthily, have started to host overgrown roots, damaging common property and increasing maintenance cost significantly, and also posing a safety hazard in some cases, especially for the elderly and infirm.

sections.label: Dislodged car park slabs from tree roots
sections.summary: Two years later the Town Council received feedback about dislodged car park slabs as surrounding trees grew and roots encroached into the car park.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: A mere two years later, the Town Council started to receive feedback about dislodged car park slabs as the surrounding trees continue to grow and their roots expand further, encroaching into the car park.

sections.label: NParks arborist numbers reviewed
sections.summary: The Minister said NParks employs 200 arborists and NParks and MND continually review resources to ensure sufficient arborists for work requirements.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: In a reply to my Parliamentary Question last week, the Minister said that NParks currently employs 200 arborists, and NParks and MND continually review resources to ensure that there are sufficient arborists to handle the work requirements.

sections.label: External tree experts for investigations
sections.summary: The speaker asks the Government to consider engaging external tree experts to independently investigate fallen trees that caused significant damage, injury or death.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Further, to complement the work of the arborists, I would like to ask the Government to consider engaging external tree experts to conduct independent investigations in cases where fallen trees have caused significant damage to property or have led to personal injury or death, which I understand is the practice elsewhere.

sections.label: Commercialisation of facility names in Singapore
sections.summary: The passage lists examples of commercialised facility names in Singapore, including galleries, a garden, an arena and an aquatic centre.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Today, we see the commercialisation of facility names all over Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: We have the DBS Singapore Gallery and the UOB Southeast Asia Gallery at the National Gallery Singapore, the Far East Organisation Children's Garden at Gardens by the Bay, the OCBC Arena and the OCBC Aquatic Centre at the Singapore Sports Hub.

sections.label: Naming of national icons and hospitals
sections.summary: The passage recalls a 2013 statement that national sports icons' names would not be commercialised, and notes two government-funded hospitals named after donors.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Some clarity from the Government was seen in 2013 when it came to national icons, such as the National Stadium and Sports Hub.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Then Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth Lawrence Wong noted in a Parliamentary answer that while OCBC had donated significantly to the project, the names of such national sports icons would not be commercialised.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: We now have the Khoo Teck Puat and Ng Teng Fong General Hospitals.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: These hospitals were fully-funded from Government grants, with the donors reportedly giving a fraction of that towards various healthcare programmes.

sections.label: URA guidelines for naming buildings
sections.summary: The passage states URA guidelines say names of persons should not be used unless there is significant cause, and asks how carefully donors' reputations are assessed.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: URA has guidelines for the naming of buildings, which say that the names of persons, living or dead, should not be used unless there is significant cause to do so.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Persons who are honoured have to be "outstanding persons who have made significant contributions to Singapore." Before granting approval of names, how carefully does the Government assess the reputation of donors?

sections.label: Rail Corridor housing test-bed
sections.summary: The passage states a 16-hectare site in Choa Chu Kang within the former KTM railway line will be a test-bed for future housing with 3,000 units.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Trade and Industry and the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: Under the Rail Corridor development, there is a 16-hectare site in Choa Chu Kang within the stretch of former Keretapi Tanah Melayu (KTM) railway line that will be a test-bed for a future housing concept with 3,000 units.

sections.label: Hot spring land transfer and tender
sections.summary: The passage states MINDEF will return hot spring land to SLA for transfer to NParks, and an NParks tender for consultancy services has drawn public and media interest.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Defence (MINDEF), after the COS last April, has announced that it was prepared to return the land occupied by the hot spring to SLA, which will then transfer the land to NParks for further development.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
sentences.text: More recently, an open tender by NParks for multi-disciplinary consultancy services for the hot spring area to be developed into a park has sparked public interest and media interest as well.

sections.label: Regulating short-term rentals
sections.summary: The speaker proposes regulating short-term rentals instead of banning them, through a licensed and tiered quota system.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: Rather than ban short-term rentals, we should regulate it by perhaps introducing a licensed and a tiered quota system.

sections.label: Compulsory guest deposit
sections.summary: The speaker asks whether a compulsory guest deposit can be implemented, forfeited if legitimate complaints are received.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: Can we also implement a compulsory deposit for the guests, which I understand is currently not the industry norm, and the deposit should be forfeited if legitimate complaints are received.

sections.label: Resident at MPS
sections.summary: On 19 December 2016, a resident came to the speaker's MPS.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: On 19 December 2016, a resident came to my MPS.

sections.label: Email to URA on parking
sections.summary: The speaker emailed URA to look into the issue and arrange alternative parking for valid season parking holders before lots are removed.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: I sent an email to URA asking them to quickly look into this issue.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: I told URA that for those who have valid season parking, URA should arrange alternative parking before the lots are removed.

sections.label: URA reply on parking
sections.summary: The speaker emailed URA for status; URA replied two days later explaining the lot removals and that it had informed LTA to adopt a light touch on enforcement.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: Again, I emailed to URA asking them what is the status of my previous email.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: This time, they replied quite fast, two days later, explaining the reason why the parking lots were removed and they said that they had earlier informed LTA to adopt a light touch on enforcement.

sections.label: Heavy vehicle parking progress
sections.summary: The speaker asks the Minister to update on progress and waitlist numbers for heavy vehicle parking, in general and in Nee Soon South.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: In January 2016, the Senior Minister of State said that MND is looking into ways to help heavy vehicle owners and workers to find more convenient parking lots.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: Can the Minister update us on the progress and how many applicants are on the waitlist in general, and Nee Soon South in particular.

sections.label: Rail Corridor design and test track
sections.summary: URA will share the design for a four-km Rail Corridor stretch in May and launch a 400-metre test track along Choa Chu Kang Road later this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In May, URA will share the design for the four-km stretch of the Corridor, from Bukit Timah Railway Station to Hillview Road.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: To prepare for this, URA will launch a 400-metre test track along Choa Chu Kang Road later this year to test possible types of surface material that may be used for the Rail Corridor trail, while retaining its rustic character.

sections.label: NParks growing area into park
sections.summary: NParks will sensitively grow the area into a park, enhancing greenery while retaining its rustic character, with work starting at the end of this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: NParks will grow the area sensitively into a park, enhancing greenery while retaining its rustic character.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Work will start at the end of this year.

sections.label: Enhancing marine ecosystem resilience
sections.summary: NParks is working with academia and environmental interest groups to enhance the resilience of marine ecosystems and manage the impact.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: To manage the impact, NParks is working with academia and environmental interest groups to enhance the resilience of our marine ecosystems.

sections.label: Built environment sector contract values
sections.summary: In 2016 the built environment sector had around $26 billion of building and civil engineering contracts, $1 billion less than 2015, with $28 billion to $35 billion expected this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In 2016, the built environment sector had around $26 billion of building and civil engineering contracts or $1 billion less than in 2015.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We expect between $28 billion to $35 billion in contracts to be awarded this year.

sections.label: Public sector construction demand projects
sections.summary: Projects include Tengah HDB Town, Circle Line 6 and Changi Airport Terminal 5, with public sector demand expected to make up 70% of overall construction demand this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: These include Tengah HDB Town, LTA's Circle Line 6, Changi Airport Terminal 5 and more.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We expect public sector demand to make up 70% of overall construction demand this year.

sections.label: Bringing forward public infrastructure projects
sections.summary: As announced by the Minister for Finance during the Budget, $700 million in public infrastructure projects will be brought forward to start construction this year and next.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In addition, as announced by the Minister for Finance during the Budget, we will bring forward $700 million in public infrastructure projects to start construction this year and next.

sections.label: CPCF commitments and firms
sections.summary: At end 2016, about $450 million of CPCF was committed, benefiting over 9,000 firms.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: At end 2016, some $450 million of CPCF has been committed, benefiting more than 9,000 firms.

sections.label: Public Sector Construction Productivity Fund
sections.summary: A $150 million Public Sector Construction Productivity Fund will offset the premium for adopting DfMA technologies for public projects.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As announced during the Budget, we will implement the $150 million Public Sector Construction Productivity Fund to offset the premium for adopting DfMA technologies for public projects.

sections.label: Construction Industry Transformation Map
sections.summary: To accelerate Built Environment sector transformation, work with industry on a Construction Industry Transformation Map.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: To accelerate the transformation of our Built Environment sector, we will be working closely with the industry on a Construction Industry Transformation Map (ITM).

sections.label: Code of Practice pilot and launch
sections.summary: BCA is piloting the Code of Practice at a few projects and will formally launch it around end of this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: BCA is piloting the Code of Practice at a few projects to refine it and will formally launch the Code of Practice sometime at the end of this year.

sections.label: CORENET e-submission platform upgrade
sections.summary: To complement BIM building plan submission, the CORENET e-submission platform will be upgraded and redeveloped to make the process easier.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: To complement the submission of building plans via BIM, we will upgrade and redevelop the CORENET e-submission platform to make the process easier to use.

sections.label: Internationalisation taskforce for companies
sections.summary: An internationalisation taskforce with public and private representatives will study support and synergies across five sectors for companies expanding abroad.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Companies that wish to expand abroad may lack sufficient capital and overseas contacts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: They may be unfamiliar with overseas markets and regulations and these are serious issues, so we have formed an internationalisation taskforce with public and private sector representatives to study ways where we can provide support.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The taskforce will identify synergies across the Construction, Real Estate, Security, Environmental Services and Landscape sectors to see if our companies can band together and provide integrated services.

sections.label: ROH3 proposals for three towns
sections.summary: ROH3 proposals for Woodlands, Pasir Ris and Toa Payoh are being refined based on feedback from 400 residents and local stakeholders.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Under ROH3, we are now refining the proposals for Woodlands, Pasir Ris and Toa Payoh based on the earlier round of feedback from 400 residents and local stakeholders.

sections.label: Remaining HIP-eligible flats selection
sections.summary: At the individual home level, selection of the approximately 70,000 remaining flats eligible for HIP will be finalised.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Third, at the individual home level, we will finalise the selection of the approximately 70,000 remaining flats eligible for the Home Improvement Programme (HIP).

sections.label: Financial support for Town Councils' lifts
sections.summary: New grants and measures provide Town Councils additional financial support for lift maintenance, replacement and retrofitting, totalling over $1 billion over 10 years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: First, we recently introduced a set of new grants and measures to provide additional financial support for Town Councils, specifically for lift maintenance.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: These include the new Lift Maintenance Grant, 50% matching of Town Councils' contributions to their Lift Replacement Funds (LRF) and the new Lift Enhancement Programme to retrofit some 20,000 older lifts with additional safety features.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: All in, this additional financial support to Town Councils will come up to more than $100 million a year, or over $1 billion over the next 10 years.

sections.label: Drop in tree failures
sections.summary: Tree failures fell around three-fold from about 3,000 cases a year in 2001 to over 800 in 2016, with NParks' tree management programme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The number of tree failures has dropped around three-fold from 2001 to 2016, with the introduction of NParks' comprehensive tree management programme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: So, the numbers are from about 3,000 cases of tree failure a year in 2001 to over 800 cases in 2016 against a backdrop of seven million trees in total − two million along streets, streetscapes, parks that NParks specifically focuses on.

sections.label: Heavy vehicle parking lots and waitlist
sections.summary: Nationwide heavy vehicle parking lots exceed registered heavy vehicles, while Yishun's public lots are heavily subscribed with about 250 applicants waitlisted.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: On a nation-wide basis, the 43,000 heavy vehicle parking lots greatly exceed the 33,000 heavy vehicles registered with LTA.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In Yishun, there are 1,270 lots, of which 866 are public lots.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As the public lots are near residential areas, they are heavily subscribed with about 250 applicants on the waitlist.

sections.label: Short-term rental regulations details
sections.summary: URA will soon put out details on allowing short-term rentals subject to conditions, and seek further stakeholder feedback before finalising regulations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: During the recent debate on amendments to the Planning Act, the Minister for National Development had mentioned plans to allow such short-term rentals subject to appropriate conditions and safeguards.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: URA will be putting out the details on this soon and we will seek further feedback and inputs from stakeholders before finalising the regulations.

sections.label: HDB flexibility on MOP
sections.summary: HDB will exercise case-by-case flexibility for those who may not have met the MOP due to overseas work or other reasons.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: But HDB recognises that there are some who may need to go overseas for a period of time for work or other reasons and who may not have met the MOP.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And HDB will exercise flexibility on a case-by-case basis.

sections.label: GLS sites transport connections
sections.summary: URA includes in GLS tender specifications a requirement for developers to provide public connections to transport nodes where feasible.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: At a broader level and in general, when we issue or launch GLS sites located near to residential and HDB estates, URA does include in its tender specifications a requirement for the developer to, where feasible, provide connections to transport nodes, such as bus stops or MRT stations that are accessible to the public.

sections.label: Government retains naming rights
sections.summary: Financial contributions do not automatically warrant a naming opportunity, and the Government retains naming rights of public buildings, roads and key infrastructure.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Financial contributions do not automatically warrant a naming opportunity and the Government retains the naming rights of public buildings, roads and other key public infrastructure.

sections.label: Singapore imports essential staples
sections.summary: Given land scarcity, Singapore depends on imports for basic and essential staples such as rice, wheat, vegetables and meat.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon
sentences.text: Given our land scarcity, we are dependent on imports for basic and essential staples, such as rice, wheat, vegetables and meat.

sections.label: Food price inflation question
sections.summary: A Member recalls 2005-2007 food price inflation and asks what strategy the Government pursues to keep food supply stable and prices reasonable.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon
sentences.text: Singaporeans may also remember that in 2005-2007, there was a bout of food price inflation due to volatility in the world markets, which led to some of our economy rice hawkers to raise the price of an additional bowl of rice by 10 cents to 50 cents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon
sentences.text: While many of the fundamental causes of price volatility are external and ultimately beyond our control, I would nevertheless like to ask the Government what strategy the country is pursuing to ensure that our food supply remains stable and our prices remain reasonable for the average man on the street.

sections.label: Promoting Recirculating Aquaculture System
sections.summary: Noting Singapore imports some 90% of its food, a Member asks whether AVA will work with local partners to promote the Recirculating Aquaculture System.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, Sir, as a small nation with not much agricultural or arable land, Singapore ends up importing much of its food − some 90% according to AVA.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David
sentences.text: Would AVA be working with local partners to promote the Recirculating Aquaculture System (ARS) in Singapore?

sections.label: Singapore food imports
sections.summary: Singapore imports more than 90% of its food from 160 countries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Singapore imports more than 90% of its food from 160 countries.

sections.label: Food waste per person
sections.summary: Last year, each person in Singapore generated 140 kilogrammes of food waste.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Last year, each person in Singapore generated 140 kilogrammes (kg) of food waste.

sections.label: Leafy vegetable farm output
sections.summary: In 2015, farms produced about 11,420 tonnes of leafy vegetables, up 21% from 2010, amounting to 13% of Singapore's vegetable supply.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: In 2015, our farms produced about 11,420 tonnes of leafy vegetables, up 21% from 2010.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: This amounts to 13% of Singapore's vegetable supply.

sections.label: Agriculture Productivity Fund update
sections.summary: The passage asks whether the Minister would provide an update on the $63 million Agriculture Productivity Fund.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Would the Minister also provide an update on the $63 million Agriculture Productivity Fund (APF)?

sections.label: Business Improvement Districts model
sections.summary: The BID model has businesses and business-funded associations improve a defined commercial area, and the CFE recommended a BID to empower precinct associations such as the Orchard Road Business Association.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: The other approach is the Business Improvement Districts (BID) model where businesses and business-funded associations come together to improve a defined commercial area.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: The CFE recommended a BID to empower precinct associations, such as the Orchard Road Business Association.

sections.label: Sustainability, haze and palm oil labelling
sections.summary: The passage covers expediting water- and energy-efficient technologies, sharing industry practices, incentives for developers, and consumer anti-haze efforts through palm oil labelling, noting the EU changed food labelling regulations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Ensuring environmental sustainability also includes implementing measures to expedite the adoption of more water- and energy-efficient technologies in our buildings and facilities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Will the Government share the good practices adopted by the industry so that more can learn from these examples?

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: And will the Government consider incentives for developers who adopt more environmentally-friendly designs and technologies in their developments?

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: Consumers play their part in the anti-haze efforts if they consciously buy from companies which only source sustainable haze-free palm oil in their products.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: However, palm oil is often labelled as vegetable oil in Singapore, which means that consumers are kept in the dark about whether the products they buy contain palm oil.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: To inform consumers on what they are consuming, the European Union have changed their food labelling regulations to ensure that the types of vegetable oil used in food products were explicitly stated on the labels.

sections.label: Illegal wildlife trade at borders
sections.summary: Singapore detected only 10 illegal wildlife trade cases at border checkpoints in three years, suggesting trade passes through undetected.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: Next, Singapore is frequently under the spotlight as a hub for illegal wildlife trade, but Singapore detected only 10 cases of illegal wildlife trade in the last three years at our border checkpoints, which suggests that wildlife trade continues to pass through our borders without our knowledge.

sections.label: Thailand sniffer dog unit cost
sections.summary: In Thailand, training and maintaining the entire sniffer dog unit costs merely S$58,000 annually.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: In Thailand, the training and maintenance of the entire sniffer dog unit functions on merely S$58,000 annually.

sections.label: AVA wildlife sniffer dog programme
sections.summary: The passage asks whether AVA would reconsider implementing a wildlife sniffer dog programme, noting only three inspectors in its wildlife section.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: Would AVA reconsider the decision to implement a wildlife sniffer dog programme in Singapore?

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: There are currently only three inspectors at the wildlife section at AVA.

sections.label: Engaging animal welfare groups
sections.summary: The passage asks whether AVA would engage animal welfare groups, noting Singapore imports 90% or more of its food.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: As such, would AVA consider engaging animal welfare groups to complement its efforts, just as NEA engages and empowers citizens for anti-littering efforts?

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: These are valid concerns because at the end of the day, we import 90% or more of the food that we consume.

sections.label: Three National Food Baskets
sections.summary: With global supplies eventually outstripped by demand, the passage calls for more concerted action and envisions perhaps "Three National Food Baskets".

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: With global supplies eventually being outstripped by demand, it is time for us to take more concerted action.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: We should envision perhaps "Three National Food Baskets".

sections.label: Singaporean agricultural producers visit Brunei
sections.summary: Last month, the speaker led a delegation of Singaporean agricultural producers to Brunei to explore opportunities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Just last month, I led a delegation of Singaporean agricultural producers to Brunei to explore opportunities.

sections.label: Overseas farms and food security
sections.summary: Overseas local food producers, such as the KR Apollo fish farm in Brunei, are expected to strengthen Singapore's food security.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Naturally, we hope that some of the food that our farms produce there will eventually be re-exported back to Singapore for our local consumption.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: We hope these will continue to remain in the farms in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: But overall, having our local food producers successfully operating overseas will strengthen our food security.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: For example, a Singapore-Brunei joint venture company, KR Apollo, for which I did the ground-breaking just a short while ago, will transform a 12-hectare site in Brunei into a high-tech vertical fish farm, the very first in Brunei.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The yield is expected to eventually reach 5,000 tonnes a year.

sections.label: Local food production targets
sections.summary: Local food production targets are 10% for vegetables, 30% for hen eggs and 15% for food fish, with production generally rising.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Our local food production targets are 10% for vegetables, 30% for hen eggs and 15% for food fish, and our production has generally been rising over the years.

sections.label: Farm Transformation Map
sections.summary: A Farm Transformation Map was developed to guide transformation of the farming sector in four areas.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Through focus group discussions involving the ICP as well as meeting up with farmers directly, we developed a Farm Transformation Map (FTM) to guide the transformation of our farming sector in four areas − physical space, innovation, people development and the larger broader ecosystem.

sections.label: Closed containment aquaculture systems
sections.summary: Closed containment aquaculture systems can reduce coastal fish farms' vulnerability to environmental risks.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: For instance, technologies like closed containment aquaculture systems (CCAS) can reduce the vulnerability of our coastal fish farms and their stocks to environmental risks.

sections.label: Support measures for farms
sections.summary: APF will disburse up to 30% of approved funding upfront, farm leases will increase to 20 years, and AVA will adopt account management.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: We have listened to the suggestions put forth by ICP.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Therefore, from April this year, APF will disburse up to 30% of the approved funding quantum upfront to facilitate the adoption of technology.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: This will complement our move to increase the tenure of farmlands to 20-year leases, from the previous 10-plus-10, based on industry feedback.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: AVA will also adopt a new "account management" approach to our farms.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: This means that each farm will have a dedicated account manager to advise them on business development, technology adoption and financial assistance.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Think of these account managers as the equivalent of SPRING Singapore for our farming industry.

sections.label: Real Estate Industry Transformation Map
sections.summary: MND is bringing together real estate stakeholders to collectively develop a Real Estate Industry Transformation Map.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: MND is, therefore, bringing together industry stakeholders across the entire real estate value chain − this includes property developers, estate agents, conveyancing and valuation firms − to collectively develop a Real Estate Industry Transformation Map (Real Estate ITM).

sections.label: HDB resale transaction review
sections.summary: HDB is reviewing its resale transaction processes to significantly reduce total transaction time, possibly by removing one resale appointment using ICT.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: HDB is already doing a review of its resale transaction processes with the aim of significantly reducing total transaction time.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: One possibility we are considering is to do away with one of the HDB's resale appointments by leveraging ICT technology.

sections.label: Clover estate EUP Batch Nine
sections.summary: Clover estate is approved for EUP Batch Nine, with consultants being appointed, hoped by June or July this year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Mr Chong Kee Hiong's example of Clover estate, which is one of the private estates that he asked about earlier, under the EUP, the estate has already been approved for Batch Nine, and I believe we are in the process of calling for tender evaluation now to appoint the consultants.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: We do hope by June or July this year that we will finish appointing all the consultants, for which they can then work with the relevant working committees to plan for the schedule for EUP in Batch Nine, going forward.

sections.label: Waivers for a family
sections.summary: HDB waived both the income ceiling and the 30-month debarment for the family.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: HDB waived both the income ceiling and the 30-month debarment for the family.

sections.label: Family in Bedok rental flat
sections.summary: HDB waived the income ceiling for them, and the family is now in a 2-room rental flat in Bedok.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: HDB waived the income ceiling for them and, today, the family is in a 2-room rental flat in Bedok.

sections.label: ASSIST flats and applicants
sections.summary: Since May 2013, 887 flats were set aside under ASSIST; of 282 applicants before 2016, 199 booked a flat.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Since May 2013, 887 flats were set aside under ASSIST.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Of the 282 applicants received before 2016, 199 or 71% went on to book a flat.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Of the remainder, 66 of them or 23% did not proceed despite qualifying.

sections.label: JSS flats and Fresh Start
sections.summary: Since 2015, 180 JSS rental flats with partitions were made available, 320 more are under construction, and Fresh Start received 68 applications.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Since 2015, HDB has made available 180 JSS rental flats with partitions for more privacy.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Another 320 of such flats are now under construction.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: I would now like to close with an update on the Fresh Start Housing Scheme, which opened last December for second-timer families in public rental.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: We have received 68 applications from families who meet the basic profile, in terms of demographics and housing situation.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: I am pleased to say that 13 families have been emplaced, and four of them have already applied for their 2-room flexi flats in HDB's sales exercise last month.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: A few more are awaiting their emplacement interviews and another 48 applications are being processed.

sections.label: Temporary Loan for back-to-back buyers
sections.summary: Anyone with an existing flat who sells it to buy a new flat using proceeds and savings needs a Temporary Loan, which will be extended to them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: On the first question, the answer is that anyone with an existing flat who wants to sell the flat and buy a new flat using the proceeds from the sale of the flat as well as their savings, so they want to do a back-to-back but then the back-to-back is very difficult to do.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: They have to do it on the same day so they typically need a Temporary Loan and we will extend that to anybody in that category.

sections.label: ICPHs operational and 2020 target
sections.summary: Two ICPHs are operational and two under construction, with a target of 10 by 2020 and all operational by about 2022.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Two are already operational and two are under construction.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We target to have 10 ICPHs by 2020 and all should be operational by about 2022 or thereabouts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We aim to target to push it up to 40% by 2020 and beyond.

sections.label: Food Fund awards to farms
sections.summary: Farms previously tapped the Food Fund, in which about $31 million was awarded to 310 projects.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Farms have previously tapped on what we had previously called the Food Fund in which about $31 million was awarded to 310 projects.

sections.label: Tree inspection records kept indefinitely
sections.summary: The tree inspection records will be kept indefinitely.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The tree inspection records will be kept indefinitely.

sections.label: No EUP, Batch Nine progressing
sections.summary: EUP would not be done at the moment, Batch Nine is progressing, and the budget is allocated for up to 10 batches.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong
sentences.text: So, I am referring to whether we could bring back a programme, such as EUP, that was previously there.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: We would not be doing EUP at the moment.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In fact, we are progressing with Batch Nine at the moment.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The budget has been allocated for up to 10 batches.

sections.label: Taxing residential holding property entity owners
sections.summary: The intent is to treat significant owners of residential holding property entities who transfer shares the same as buying and selling property directly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: The intent of what we are trying to do is to treat significant owners of residential holding property entities, who transfer shares in these entities, in the same way as if they were to buy and sell property directly.
